content_of_post_to_comment: If your entire argument is that professor so&so or organization X says this, then you don't have an actual argument. You're just parroting someone else's conclusion. If you can't make your own argument, you haven't spent enough time thinking or studying the topic to speak on it.
comment: There’s also a difference between borrowing authority and building on expertise. A strong argument can cite others, but the real test is whether you can explain the reasoning when the citation is removed.
